controls.label: FPI OFT adapter upgrade Safe through one-day timelock
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531776, adapter EIP-1967 slots resolved to implementation 0x2063961F... and ProxyAdmin 0x223a681f.... ProxyAdmin.owner() returned legacy Frax Timelock 0xb898Ad2976b4d8f2E21521C9db16b7497825E503; delay() returned 86400 and admin() returned this 4/7 Safe. The Safe had no enabled modules and a zero guard. This path can replace the adapter's uncapped _credit mint logic after one day.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531776, FPI minters(0x9033bAd7...) returned true. The live adapter proxy resolved to FraxOFTMintableAdapterUpgradeable 0x2063961F..., whose verified _credit calls uncapped FPI minter_mint. Its EIP-1967 admin was ProxyAdmin 0x223a681f..., whose owner was the 86400-second Timelock 0xb898Ad2976b4d8f2E21521C9db16b7497825E503, administered by the 4/7 Safe 0xfFFffF4F3baC444b2C0ecf2A1840d018bE783937. Separately, FPI owner 3/5 Safe 0x6A7efa96... can immediately add or remove uncapped minters. The previous abbreviated timelock address did not identify the live owner contract and has been replaced with the exact RPC-returned address. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the 3-of-5 Comptroller Safe can immediately replace uncapped minters, while the issuer collateral index does not prove whole-supply reconciliation across Ethereum and satellite mint routes and no independent attestor or prudential supervisor is evidenced. Reconciliation determination 2026-08-15 (revised): unknown retained with the uncovered route named. The ControllerPool path is on-chain collateral-gated, but the verified OFT mintable adapter mints canonical FPI uncapped via _credit/minter_mint on message receipt without collateral, so issuance is not fully collateral-gated and not-applicable does not fit. The frax-fpi-collateral feed is composition-only (ferry/liability entries excluded) and joins no supply-side liabilities, so it cannot evidence continuous/periodic coverage of that adapter route. A whole-supply liability reconciliation covering the mintable-adapter route, or a verified OFT burn/mint conservation proof, would resolve this. Wave 1 reconciliation re-check: Frax's FPI overview and Controller Pool docs describe 100% collateral-ratio AMO minting and redemption, but the collateral feed is a composition snapshot that excludes ferry/liability entries and does not reconcile all token liabilities; the uncapped OFT adapter route remains uncovered, so reconciliation remains unknown.
